Under the pre-sale process allocated blocks will subsequently be serviced and subdivided in accordance with agreed upon sales terms with qualifying eligible contractors.
Administration is going forward with a base market list price of $15,750 per front meter with adjustments to the baseless price for specific location characteristics of each block.
A full list of block pricing including sizes and characteristics can be found in appendix 1.

Appendix 2 indicates the standard terms under which offers on the parcels will be considered and evaluated by Saskatoon land while appendix 3 outlines the general structure of the pre-sale allocation process.

This report is in response to a resolution from May 8th to 2024 where the finance committee resolved that administration report back in the year on the progress of the city's e-bill program.

I'm happy to report e-bill participation as seen a significant rise in 2025 with over 47% of utility customers now receiving their bill via the electronic option, which is a 13% increase since that report of May of 2024.
This 13% increase can be largely attributed to the following three reasons.
Number one e-bill is the suggested default for all new customers.
Number two, we have made administration has made e-bill notification improvements.
And number three, the Canada Post strike.
One thing to mention, despite this increase in e-bill participation, the costs associated with mailing physical bills has also risen sharply since May of 2024.
This increase in costs has resulted in the, excuse me, did result in the city spending approximately 875,743 dollars in 2024 to print and mail utility bills, which is an increase of 1.5% over 2023.
Cost for 2025 are trending in the same direction where we're seeing an increase in printing and mailing costs despite the decline in customers who still receive a physical bill.
A jurisdictional scan of other utility service providers does show that many also have continued to see an increase in electronic billing participation.
And in addition, no utility service providers surveyed does charge for physical bills as was the same in 2024.
With that, the report is recommended to be received as information and administration would be happy to answer any questions committee may have.

Sort of Q3 of 2026.
